name: Split Conformal Prediction Calibration
definition: A calibration method that yields provable, distribution-free per-ray coverage guarantees at any user-specified confidence level, using a held-out calibration set to preserve exchangeability.
summary: Split Conformal Prediction Calibration is a post-hoc method that adjusts uncertainty estimates in neural radiance fields using a held-out set to ensure provable, distribution-free coverage guarantees.
